comparison.objective: Recover media through a screen vs attach a booster-seat tray at the second notch.
comparison.physical_skill: Granular bridge clearing and screen reseating vs bimanually align a wide tray and engage two separated catches at one indexed setting.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media mass and retained washers with clean release vs both catches locked in notch two, tray supported and centred, booster unmoved, hands clear.
comparison.reason: The record tests wide-part alignment and simultaneous latching, not particle classification.
